title: BOLI ZAINAB UTHO IMDAD KO AAO ABBAS
body:
BOLI ZAINAB UTHO IMDAD KO AAO ABBAS
ZIBHA HOTA HAE MERA BHAYI ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
SAR TOH SHAH KA AB SAJDAE QALIQ MEIN JHUKA
HAATH SE SHUMR KE QANJAR KO CHUDAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
AB SAKINA PAH YATEEMI KA SITAM TOOT GAYA
AB TARAS KHAO KALEJE SE LAGAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
AAG QAIMON MEIN LAGANE CHALE AAE HAIN ADOO
GHASH MEIN HAE ABEDE BEEMAR JAGAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
JO RIDAH HAZRATE ZEHRA KI THI MERE SAR PAR
WOH RIDAH SHUMR NE CHEENE HAE DILAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
LAASHE BESAR SE HAE LIPTI HUI NANHI BACHHI
AAO NADAAN SAKINA KO CHUDAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
MERE BAAZU MEIN RASAN BAANDHTA HAE SHUMRE SHAQI
IS AZEEYAT SE BEHAN KO TOH BACHAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
SAATH GHURBAT MEIN YATEEMON KO NA CHODO BHAIYA
MAIN BULAATI HOON MERE PAAS TOH AAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
HONE TASHEER CHALI JAATI HAE NASHAAD BEHAN
FOUJE AADA KO JALAL APNA DIKHAO ABBAS
<<DIVIDER>>
TUMSE KARTI HOON SIFAARISH YEHI HYDER KE LIYE
APNE QADMON MEIN JAGAH USKO DILAO ABBAS
